input.quote: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES, PRODUCTS, DATA, APPARATUS AND SOFTWARE "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND
input.rationale: IBM warrants only reasonable care and skill, with no conformance warranty, no warranty period and no repair/replace/refund remedy, and 5.4 puts all Materials on an "AS IS" basis while disclaiming capacity, performance and error-free operation. Redline adds a 90-day conformance warranty with a real remedy and excludes the express warranties from the disclaimer.

input.quote: Risk of loss for all Base Components shall at all times remain with IBM. Risk of loss for all Customer Components shall at all times remain with Customer.
input.rationale: There is no insurance clause anywhere in the agreement even though IBM hosts our environment and processes our Content and personal data. Redline inserts a short CGL / E&O / cyber insurance clause with certificates on request after 14.12.

input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage.
input.rationale: The Base Terms contain no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-cap obligation; charges follow the Services ordered and capacity changes are requested at our discretion (11.5). We should still check Attachment A and each Service Option Attachment for committed volumes before signature.

input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable.
input.rationale: Section 3.5 deals only with our payment obligations; the agreement contains no transition assistance, data return/export or deletion-certification obligation for a hosting vendor holding our Content. Redline inserts the standard six-month assistance, 30-day data return and certified deletion provisions.
